title: UI Component
description: A server-rendered template that renders a node of a resource's JSON in a mode (view or edit).

rbac_context.description: UI components are stored only in the default context.

name.description: The component's site-wide unique name. The scrud: prefix is reserved for built-ins.

scopes.description: Maps a property name (or "*" for array items) to the scope name its child is rendered in.

stylesheets.description: Names of the stylesheets that apply to this component.
